This update was also given the name ''Gatling Gun Update'' as it added the [[Gatling Gun]] tower. This update encompassed six versions, the main v1.32.0 update (released 18 September 2024) and five minor updates, the v1.32.1 update (released 18 September 2024), v1.32.2 (released 18 September 2024), v1.32.2a (released 19 September 2024), v1.32.2b (released 20 September 2024) and v1.32.2c (released 21 September 2024). ==Additions== ===Towers=== *[[Gatling Gun]] ===Miscellanous=== *Swap Hotbar Keybind *Upgrade Bottom Path Keybind ==Changes & Bugfixes== *Updated upgrade UI. **Updated appearance. **Added double upgrade path support for future towers and reworks. **Upgrades now feel instant and responsive. **Updated tool tips, now instead of showing a pop up with the text inside of it, it now collapses the text behind an orange toggle. **Option selection is now collapsed, only showing the currently selected option if not expanded. **Option selection and unit spawners no longer slowly circle around the icon, they now only progress when a second passes. **Targeting options when hovered over now show the number of options available. **Upgrade description now has a scroll bar if there is too much text, instead of shrinking the text. **Hovering over detection icons now show the name of the detection. **Tower previews now showcase the current level of the tower and equipped skin, with background based on the rarity of the skin. **Both vertical and horizontal upgrade UI can now be used on mobile. *Default keybind for swapping hotbar changed from T to Q. *Moved Wave 16 [[Fallen Mode|Fallen]] mode dialogue to Wave 14 and Wave 33 [[Fallen Mode|Fallen]] mode dialogue to Wave 30 to match the wave debuts of enemies mentioned in these dialogues. *Fixed {{Color|Other|Mako}} skin being purchasable while not owning the [[DJ Booth]]. *Fixed tool tips being moved out of the upgrade description when there it too much text in the update description, also moving the sell button out of the upgrade box if vertical upgrade setting is being used. *Fixed [[Mercenary Base]] spawnrate timers now display time remaining for a unit to spawn correctly. *Fixed tower sell cost visually not accounting for the discount buff, while sell cost did actually decrease the sell button would list it as if it was unaffected by discount buff. *Fixed tower placement footprint being displayed at the lowest possible spot instead of being at the same level as the tower while placing it down. *Fixed [[Jester]] using the wrong ''Equip Bombs'' icon. :In '''v1.32.1''': *Fixed upgrading with a controller not working correctly. :In '''v1.32.2''': *Version number changed from ''v1.32.1'' to ''v1.32.2''. :In '''v1.32.2a''': *[[Talk Like a Pirate Day]] modifier is now active on all maps. :In '''v1.32.2b''': *[[Talk Like a Pirate Day]] modifier is no longer active on all maps. :In '''v1.32.2c''': *[[Deluxe Crate]], [[Premium Crate]], {{SpinTicket|Spin Tickets}}, [[Phantom Crate]] and [[High Grade Crate]] can no longer be purchased by players in Australia. ==Gallery==
